title: CyFj11 validation suite and R package source: synthetic test workspaces, FCS files, and analysis scripts for FlowJo v11 / R interoperability
description: This record provides the materials needed to reproduce the validation results reported in the CyFj11 manuscript (Jagla, Cytometry Part A, submitted). It contains: (1) the complete flowjo_export_tests/ validation suite, including 14 test scenarios (tests 01-13: synthetic FCS data and exported FlowJo v10 workspaces; test 14: public FlowSOM example data), the R generator script (generate_all_tests.R), and per-population validation reports; (2) the CyFj11 R/Bioconductor package source as a versioned .tar.gz distribution; and (3) the manuscript appendices, validation scripts, and reference manual PDF referenced by the paper. The package parses FlowJo v11 workspace files and exports GatingSet objects to FlowJo v10 XML, enabling bidirectional interoperability between FlowJo and R/Bioconductor.
notes: Tests 01-13 use entirely synthetic FCS data generated by flowjo_export_tests/generate_all_tests.R with fixed random seeds. Test 14 uses the public example dataset bundled with the Bioconductor FlowSOM package (68983.fcs and gating.wsp). No human or patient-derived material is included.
